hero.title: The ERP built for fuel distribution in Africa
hero.subtitle: Zylo Office brings your fuel stations and your tanker-truck fleet together in one platform: tanks, deliveries, cash reconciliation and alerts, tracked in real time, without juggling several tools.

appShowcase.title: Two businesses, one platform
appShowcase.subtitle: Zylo Office is made of two applications, each built for a specific fuel-distribution business.

zyloLiquid.name: Zylo Liquid
zyloLiquid.description: Tank and telemetry monitoring, automatic delivery detection, per-product pricing, cash reconciliation and alerts (level, water, leak, disconnected sensor).

zyloTanker.name: Zylo Tanker
zyloTanker.description: Tanker-truck supervision, consumption tracking and transport document management.

valueProp.title: A tool built for the reality of the field, not adapted afterwards
valueProp.body: Fuel distribution has its own constraints: tanks that must be monitored continuously to avoid stockouts, a cash register that must be reconciled without ambiguity at the end of every shift, and deliveries that must be verifiable without relying solely on a paper slip. Zylo Office is designed directly around these needs, rather than being a generic ERP with fuel bolted on afterwards.

why.title: Why Zylo Office
why.body: Zylo Office is built together with station operators and tanker-truck fleets to match their real processes — not a theoretical view of their business. The platform evolves with feedback from the field.

africa.title: Built for Africa
africa.body: Each organization configures its own currency for displayed amounts — the platform does not impose a single currency.

twoBusinesses.title: Two businesses, one platform
twoBusinesses.body: Fuel stations and tanker-truck fleets are managed on the same foundation, with a shared organization and access model, instead of two separate tools you have to connect yourself.

realtime.title: Real-time data
realtime.body: Tank telemetry (Holykell sensors) is synced continuously, with a sync status visible at all times — not data entered manually once a day.

alerts.title: Automatic alerts and detection
alerts.body: High level, low level, water detected, leak, disconnected sensor: alerts are raised automatically from tank measurements, and deliveries are detected from level changes rather than declared by hand.

finalCta.subtitle: Let's talk about your network: our team sets up your organization with you for a frictionless start.
